camel_example: aliyun ens ImportImage --region cn-hangzhou --ImageName '镜像名称' --Architecture x86_64 --OSType linux --ComputeType ens_vm --ImageFormat qcow2
kebab_example: aliyun ens import-image --image-name '镜像名称' --compute-type ens_vm --os-type linux --image-format qcow2 --architecture x86_64 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportImage

parameters.help_en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为[2, 128]个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en:
The image type. Valid values:

ens_vm: ENS virtual machine image (default)
parameters.help_zh:
`镜像类型`
ens_vm：ens虚机镜像（默认）
parameters.name: compute_type

parameters.help_en: The region where the image resides. Currently, only cn-beijing is supported
parameters.name: oss_region

parameters.help_en: The OSS bucket that stores the image file
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The name of the image file
parameters.name: oss_object

parameters.help_en:
The operating system platform type. Valid values:

windows
linux

Currently, only linux is supported
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统平台类型。取值范围：

windows。
linux。

暂时只支持：linux
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en:
The operating system distribution. Valid values:
centos
ubuntu
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统发行版。取值范围：
centos
ubuntu
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en:
The image format. Valid values:</br>
qcow2.</br>
Currently, only qcow2 is supported
parameters.help_zh:
镜像格式。取值范围：</br>
qcow2。</br>
当前只支持qcow2
parameters.name: image_format

parameters.help_en:
The system architecture. Valid values:</br>

x86_64

Currently, only x86_64 is supported
parameters.help_zh:
系统架构。取值范围：</br>

x86_64。

现只支持：x86_64
parameters.name: architecture

parameters.help_en: The version of the operating system distribution
parameters.name: os_version

fields.help_en: The OSS bucket that stores the image
fields.name: oss_bucket

fields.help_en: The file name (key) of the image file stored in the OSS bucket after the image is uploaded
fields.help_zh: 镜像上传至OSS Bucket后，保存在Bucket中的镜像文件的文件名（key）
fields.name: oss_object

fields.help_en: The region where the image resides
fields.name: oss_region

parameters.help_en: The list of custom image information
parameters.help_zh: 创建的自定义镜像信息列表
parameters.name: disk_device_mapping

parameters.help_en:
The region of the destination OSS where the image is stored.</br>

Currently, only cn-beijing and ap-southeast-1 are supported
parameters.help_zh:
镜像要存储的目标OSS的区域。</br>

当前只支持cn-beijing与ap-southeast-1两个区域
parameters.name: target_oss_region_id

parameters.help_en: The image license type. Valid values: Aliyun (Alibaba Cloud license) and BYOL (Bring Your Own License)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像许可证类型。取值：Aliyun（阿里云许可证）、BYOL（自带许可证）
